import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'brand': ['Leica', 'Fuji', 'Pentax', 'Olympus', 'Leica'],
    'model_year': [2005, 2019, 2012, 2015, 2016],
    'megapixels': [13.5, 46.4, 38.7, 22.5, 12.2],
    'max_iso': [25600, 51200, 12800, 6400, 25600],
    'weight_grams': [324, 1151, 598, 1095, 290],
    'price_usd': [811.8, 3596.41, 3357.2, 1555.7, 3899.09],
    'sensor_type': ['Micro 4/3', 'APS-C', 'Full Frame', 'APS-C', 'Medium Format'],
    'has_video_4k': [1, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'lens_mount': ['E', 'EF', 'MFT', 'Z', 'MFT'],
    'body_type': ['Compact', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'DSLR']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Camera Specifications Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# 1. Scatter plot: Price vs Megapixels with ISO as size
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['megapixels'], df['price_usd'], 
                     s=df['max_iso']/500, 
                     c=df['model_year'], 
                     alpha=0.7, 
                     cmap='viridis',
                     edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)

# Add labels for each point
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    ax1.annotate(row['brand'], (row['megapixels'], row['price_usd']),
                xytext=(5, 5), textcoords='offset points',
                fontsize=8, alpha=0.8)

ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels (Size = Max ISO, Color = Year)')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1)
cbar.set_label('Model Year')

# 2. Bar plot: Average price by brand
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
price_by_brand = df.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = ax2.bar(price_by_brand.index, price_by_brand.values, 
              color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(price_by_brand)))
ax2.set_xlabel('Brand')
ax2.set_ylabel('Average Price (USD)')
ax2.set_title('Average Price by Brand')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Add value labels on bars
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax2.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 50,
            f'${height:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 3. Box plot: Weight distribution by body type
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='body_type', y='weight_grams', ax=ax3, width=0.6)
sns.stripplot(data=df, x='body_type', y='weight_grams', 
             ax=ax3, color='black', size=8, jitter=True)
ax3.set_xlabel('Body Type')
ax3.set_ylabel('Weight (grams)')
ax3.set_title('Weight Distribution by Body Type')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. Pie chart: Distribution of sensor types
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(sensor_counts)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index,
                                  autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90,
                                  colors=colors, textprops={'fontsize': 10})
ax4.set_title('Distribution of Sensor Types')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 5. Line plot: Camera specifications over years
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
df_sorted = df.sort_values('model_year')
ax5.plot(df_sorted['model_year'], df_sorted['megapixels'], 
        marker='o', label='Megapixels', linewidth=2)
ax5.plot(df_sorted['model_year'], df_sorted['max_iso']/1000, 
        marker='s', label='Max ISO (÷1000)', linewidth=2)
ax5.set_xlabel('Model Year')
ax5.set_ylabel('Value')
ax5.set_title('Specifications Trend Over Years')
ax5.legend()
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Add brand labels to points
for i, row in df_sorted.iterrows():
    ax5.annotate(row['brand'], (row['model_year'], row['megapixels']),
                xytext=(5, 5), textcoords='offset points',
                fontsize=8, alpha=0.8)

# 6. Heatmap: Correlation matrix
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
numeric_cols = ['model_year', 'megapixels', 'max_iso', 'weight_grams', 'price_usd']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', 
           cmap='coolwarm', center=0, square=True, 
           cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, ax=ax6)
ax6.set_title('Correlation Matrix of Numeric Features')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
